==Description==
The '''Heatwave''', in certain places referred to as '''Heat wave''', is a [[Consumables|consumable]] that can be obtained from the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] and by triumphing modes. It can be used to damage enemies using fire damage.

Only up to three '''Heatwaves''' can be used in a single match. Each '''Heatwaves''' has a 30 second cooldown before it can be used again.

==Usage==
When used, the '''Heatwave''' will cover the player's screen in fire and set all enemies ablaze. This applies a 6 second long burn that deals 25 damage every 0.25 ticks, while also dropping 15% defense a tick, meaning the lowest possible damage dealt is 600. As the burn debuff is actually reapplied multiple times during the '''Heatwave''', the burn debuff itself is extended. Therefore, for enemies which were on the path before it was activated, the damage can reach up to a total of 1,000. The heatwave itself which sets enemies on fire also lasts 6 seconds.

==Appearance==
When used, a giant heatwave will appear around the player. Some tumbleweed will also start appearing.

==Strategy==
*'''Heatwave''' is best used against crowds of enemies, as it can deal up to 1,000 damage to them.
**This can clear out weaker enemies like the [[Fallen Jester]], [[Elite Hazmat]] or [[Breaker4]] in a single ability usage.
**Stronger enemies like the [[Fallen Giant]] or [[Bulwark]], while not killed, will be heavily weakened by it.
*'''Heatwave''' is quite effective against enemies with defense, as its burn both ignores it, dealing full damage, and also reduces it, allowing your towers to deal more damage to them.
**Do note that this does not stack with burn from other burn defense dropping sources.
